summary: Build a weather forecast Azure Function that exposes current conditions and multi-day forecast endpoints for a location-based weather API.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace is empty, so this is a new Azure Functions app for a weather forecast backend.

questions.question: Which programming language for Weather Forecast API?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is the default choice for a clean, modern Azure Functions API and fits a weather service well.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Weather Forecast API.
questions.answer: Current weather, 5-day forecast, location lookup, optional temperature units
questions.rationale: The app is a weather forecast backend that serves current and multi-day forecast data for a location.
questions.recommendedChoice: Current weather, 5-day forecast, location lookup, optional temperature units

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?
questions.rationale: Azure Functions require Blob Storage for AzureWebJobsStorage, while the app can fetch external weather data without app-owned persistence.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store files and support Azure Functions runtime storage

questions.question: Does this app need user login?
questions.rationale: This is a public weather data API without user accounts or private per-user data.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Add a user sign-in flow and authenticated API access

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in or authenticated API access
